name: decompute
description: Cut your Claude Code token bill. A local gateway compresses context before each request — same model, same answers, fewer tokens. Bring your own key; runs entirely on your machine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Setup runs an installer command and writes Claude Code routing config. Open a folder you trust before running 'Decompute: Set Up'.

commands.title: Decompute: Set Up (install CLI + connect Claude Code)
Decompute: Copy Claude Code Setup Command
Decompute: Enable Routing (route Claude Code through the gateway)
Decompute: Ask Local Student (verified, falls back to Claude)
Decompute: Set Up Local Student Model

decompute.gatewayUrl.description: Decompute Gateway base URL. Defaults to the local gateway the setup installs on this machine; set a self-managed/hosted URL for advanced setups.

decompute.localGatewayUrl.description: Optional advanced local gateway URL used only by the local status check. Leave blank unless you installed Decompute Local Gateway separately.

decompute.pollSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, to refresh license and quota status in the status bar.

decompute.cliInstallCommand.description: Command run in a terminal by 'Decompute: Set Up' to install the `decompute` CLI when it's missing. Leave blank to use the default installer (curl … install.sh | bash). Local development: set to e.g. `bash /path/to/decompute/scripts/install.sh`. (Machine-scoped: cannot be set by a workspace, so an untrusted repo can't inject an install command.)

decompute.checkoutUrl.description: Optional override for the Pro checkout link opened by 'Upgrade to Pro'. Leave blank to use the built-in Stripe Payment Link. The buyer's device id is appended as ?client_reference_id so the purchase binds to this machine.

decompute.licenseApiUrl.description: Base URL of the Decompute license service (the Cloudflare Worker) that 'Activate Pro' fetches the signed license from after payment, e.g. https://decompute-checkout.<account>.workers.dev. Leave blank until it's deployed.

scripts.test: esbuild src/url.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/url.mjs && esbuild src/settings.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/settings.mjs && esbuild src/setup.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/setup.mjs && node --test test/url.test.mjs test/settings.test.mjs test/setup.test.mjs
